answer: Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 9 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in dune and willow lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the harbor graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1596 impostors cost 633 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
